meta.governance: Campaign UX without payment. Forms are not stored on a server.

lede: Support the mission, join the movement, or ask to be a farmer we want to support. No payment is taken here. Submissions are not stored on a server.
privacy: Give only what you are willing to put in a downloaded file on your own device. Phone numbers are not required. Nothing is sent to a database from this site.

paths.title: Farmer
paths.body: If you farm in West Bengal and want to be considered when a real intake exists, express interest. This is not enrolment and not a promise of ₹1 lakh.

paths.title: Supporter
paths.body: India and overseas supporters, including NRI friends of the Samaj, can register interest. There is no UPI, 80G, or donation receipt on this site.

paths.title: Volunteer
paths.body: No roster and no shift tool until intake is approved. You may still leave a name so a future team can contact you — only if a backend is later approved.

paths.title: Partner
paths.body: Organisations that may later walk with the mission. This is not a live sponsorship contract and not a payment.

form.intro: This form builds a file on your device. It does not pretend the Samaj has received it.

fields.label: Anything you want us to know

form.consent: I understand this file stays on my device unless I send it myself. Bharatiya Krishak Samaj has not collected this on a server.

errors.name: Please add a name.
errors.locality: Please add a locality, village or area.
errors.consent: Please confirm you understand this is not stored on a server.
errors.role: Please choose how you want to take part.

form.success: A file has been prepared on your device. It has not been uploaded. No farmer has been funded.
